reset.title: Reset
reset.subtitle: Sets a member's points, or everyone's, back to zero, and so to the first rank. For example once a year, or after testing.
reset.help: Unchecked, the points history is kept and a "Reset" row is added. Streaks start over from zero. "Also put the tasks done back to do" erases the task history (done today, tasks in the journal) and puts each task done back to do, with the due date it had before; archived one-time tasks come back. Quests done and challenges won stay counted so they do not pay twice. "Also clear the games" erases games played, their stats and learning progress; game settings stay.
reset.confirmKeep: {{who}}: points, rank and streak back to zero. The history is kept.
reset.confirmClear: {{who}}: points, rank and streak back to zero, and points history erased. This cannot be undone.
reset.clearTaskHistory: Also put the tasks done back to do
reset.confirmTasks: The tasks done go back to do, with the due date they had before, and their history is erased.
reset.clearGames: Also clear the games and their stats
reset.confirmGames: Games played, their stats and what was learned are erased; the games start over. Game settings stay.
